# Jayrun 0.3.3 — read the current graph iteration

An operator or resource setup hook can now read `self.context.iteration` directly.
It starts at 1 and advances with each graph iteration. An operator that repeats
twice in one graph pass sees the same iteration on all three executions.

For example, an operator can label a measurement with both the graph pass and
its execution number within that pass:

```python
self.context.record("position", {
    "iteration": self.context.iteration,
    "execution": self.execution.number,
})
```

The property is read-only. Applications observing a run can continue using
`run.iteration_count` to see how many graph iterations have started.
[Iteration guide](https://jayrun.readthedocs.io/en/latest/guides/runs/iteration.html)
